title: N62: Fine-grained threshold sensitivity — peak at 1.4 (Sharpe 0.914), robust [1.0, 1.6]
description: Tested Hybrid VT threshold sensitivity with 0.1 step from 0.8 to 2.5 (2014-2025). Peak Sharpe at threshold 1.4 (0.914), consistent with VRP median 1.31 (N25). Plateau [1.0, 1.6] all within 4% of peak. All thresholds 0.8-2.5 beat pure GARCH VT (0.780). MaxDD monotonically worsens as threshold rises (less VIX protection).
